name: roiva
description: Read an organization's AI initiative costs, cash value, freed capacity, cash ROI and business cases from Roiva, and draft figures a person accepts in Roiva.

interface.longDescription:
Roiva is where an organization records what each of its AI initiatives costs and the value it has delivered. This plugin lets ChatGPT read your Roiva account with your permissions and answer from it, with a link to the page in Roiva each figure came from.

Ask about:
- Your portfolio: which initiatives are live, what each has cost, and its cash ROI, over all time or a period you name.
- One initiative: its costs, its approved value, its business case against what it has delivered, the formula behind a figure and the entries behind a month.
- Cash value and freed capacity, as two figures. Value counts only approved entries. Freed capacity is hours freed, priced at what they cost; it isn't cash, and it is never added to cash value. ROI, net and payback are cash only.
- Your account's assumptions, such as its loaded hourly rate, and how earlier business cases compared with results, so a new estimate starts from your own figures.
- Integrations: which connections are healthy, and why one isn't bringing data in.
- How Roiva works, from its own help articles and setup guides.

Drafts a person accepts. Where your account allows it, ChatGPT can also draft a monthly figure Roiva is waiting for, a vendor bill's charges as an initiative's costs, or an initiative's business-case figures, each with the source it came from. Nothing in Roiva changes until a person accepts the draft in Roiva, and ChatGPT can withdraw its own drafts.

It can't approve value, book costs, move an initiative through its stages or delete anything. Those stay in Roiva.

You sign in with your Roiva account (with single sign-on where your organization requires it) and choose which account to connect. An Owner or Admin decides who may connect an assistant and who may let one draft. Every lookup is recorded in the account's audit log. Requires a Roiva account.
defaultPrompt: Which of our AI initiatives are live, and what's the cash ROI on each?
How did our live initiatives' business cases compare with what they've delivered?
Which monthly figures is Roiva waiting for me to enter?

positive.description: Portfolio ROI. The reviewer account holds Roiva's sample initiatives and one ordinary initiative, AI Support Ticket Routing & Resolution.
positive.prompt: Using Roiva, which of our AI initiatives are live, and what's the cash ROI on each?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's live initiatives with each one's cash ROI and costs. Cash value and freed capacity are reported as two separate figures and never added together. Each figure comes with its app.roiva.ai link, and any answer that quotes a total says what was left out, if anything.

positive.description: Find one initiative by name and summarize it from its cost and value records.
positive.prompt: Search Roiva for our customer support triage initiative and summarize what it has cost and the value it has delivered.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds AI Customer Support Triage and opens it. The answer gives its costs, its approved cash value and its freed capacity as separate figures, its cash ROI, and the app.roiva.ai link to the initiative.

positive.description: How Roiva works, answered from Roiva's own setup guide rather than guessed.
positive.prompt: How do I connect Zendesk to Roiva?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the steps from Roiva's Zendesk setup guide (where to go in Roiva, what to enter, what Zendesk access it needs) and links to the guide. It doesn't invent pages or buttons.

positive.description: Draft a monthly figure for a person to accept. The reviewer account's ordinary initiative asks for a monthly reading of minutes per ticket. This is a write: ChatGPT should ask the reviewer to confirm before calling propose_reading.
positive.prompt: Which monthly figures is Roiva waiting for? Draft the minutes per ticket it's asking for on AI Support Ticket Routing & Resolution as 6.5, from our Zendesk report "Handle time by month".
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the requested reading (minutes per ticket for the month Roiva asks for on AI Support Ticket Routing & Resolution), then drafts it as 6.5 with the Zendesk report as its source. The answer says nothing in Roiva changes until a person accepts the draft there, gives the link to the proposal, and doesn't say the figure was recorded.

positive.description: List and withdraw the reviewer's own draft. withdraw_proposal is marked destructive, so ChatGPT should ask the reviewer to confirm first. Run after the previous case.
positive.prompt: List my Roiva proposals and withdraw the one that's still waiting.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer's proposals with each one's status, then withdraws the pending one and says nothing else in Roiva changed.

negative.description: Approving value is a person's decision in Roiva, and no tool can approve. The plugin should not claim to approve anything.
negative.prompt: Approve all the value entries waiting for review in Roiva.

negative.description: Freed capacity isn't cash, so the plugin should not add it to cash value. Expected: it reports cash value, freed capacity and cash ROI as separate figures and explains why it won't combine them.
negative.prompt: Add our cash value and freed capacity together and give me one ROI figure for the portfolio.

negative.description: No tool deletes or changes an initiative. Expected: ChatGPT says it can't delete initiatives and that an Owner or Admin does that in Roiva, and calls no write tool.
negative.prompt: Delete the HR Onboarding Automation initiative from Roiva.

publication.release_notes: First release. Reads Roiva initiatives, costs, cash value, freed capacity, cash ROI, business cases, assumptions, integrations and help articles, and drafts monthly figures, vendor-bill costs and business-case figures for a person to accept in Roiva.
